suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention note: The silent-ignore pattern `let _ = <expr>` for error-returning operations should be avoided. All error results should be explicitly handled (propagated, logged, or intentionally discarded with a comment explaining why). Four instances of `let _ = uart.flush()` remain in app/src/main.rs outside the transport layer.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: fix-uart-flush-error review found 4 remaining `let _ = uart.flush()` instances in app/src/main.rs (lines 790, 811, 855, 861) — same class of issue as the fix, but in config/hw-test mode main functions rather than the transport layer.
